principles: Bound version bumps to user-visible CLI capability surfaces, not arbitrary repository activity.
Keep skip/build/version wording mechanically consistent with the predicate.
Preserve fail-closed exclusions for experiments, paper artifacts, and general docs.
Do not manually bump semver in DEV; the DONE merge effect owns version mutation.
drivers: B-3a4d-like proof/test/doc-only CLI capability work must no longer look invisible to users.
The existing DONE build and version bump path share one changed-path predicate.
Over-bumping on every docs/** change would create noisy semver and false release signals.

options.name: watch-only-runtime-inputs
cons: B-3a4d-like CLI proof capabilities still skip versions
Users cannot see capability proof changes through CLI semver

options.name: watch-bounded-capability-contract-inputs
pros: docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/** now count as CLI capability/proof inputs
Keeps experiments and arbitrary docs out
cons: Some docs/CLI.md-only changes will also trigger packages/main build because the predicate is shared

options.name: watch-all-docs
cons: Violates scope by bumping unrelated requirements and paper docs

rationale: The bounded policy matches the user-requested capability proof strategy without converting Proof-or-Stop semver into a repository-wide documentation ledger.

preMortem.consequence: Every requirement or paper edit creates CLI patch versions
preMortem.mitigation: Only add docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/**; keep docs/requirements and experiments false in smoke

preMortem.trigger: Predicate changes but VERSION_BUMP_SKIPPED_LINE still says runtime only
preMortem.consequence: Host cannot tell why capability proof inputs are watched
preMortem.mitigation: Update version-bump skip wording and docs together

preMortem.trigger: Developer edits package.json versions in DEV
preMortem.consequence: Version sync points drift outside DONE merge effect
preMortem.mitigation: Keep package version files excluded and rely on DONE merge policy
